missing_information_behavior: Do not add standalone iron until prenatal product contents, current elemental iron exposure and antenatal/laboratory context are reviewed.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer iron-deficiency anemia from pregnancy alone.
Do not duplicate iron already present in prenatal supplements.
Do not substitute a supplement recommendation for antenatal screening or prescribed treatment.
professional_escalation_conditions: Low hemoglobin/ferritin, anemia symptoms, bleeding, iron overload, intolerance or multiple iron-containing products.
population_and_context: Pregnant people considering bisglycinate or other iron supplements; pregnancy increases iron requirements but supplemental dose depends on prenatal care, laboratory findings and existing products.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Count elemental iron from all products and follow local antenatal guidance and clinician-directed treatment.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Iron and pregnancy reference information do not replace local antenatal protocols; dose and policy vary by jurisdiction. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
